text: General Motors raised multiple 2026 operating guidance measures while lowering net income guidance. North American operations remained the primary earnings source. The company reported reduced warranty costs, narrowing EV losses, continued EV-related cash charges, and substantially completed its announced EV pullback.

meta.note: Financial guidance changes and reported operating results coexist without resolving long-term capital allocation outcomes.

text: Novo Nordisk filed suit against Eli Lilly alleging misleading comparative advertising for GLP-1 medicines and requested injunctive relief and damages. The claims reference differing clinical evidence and advertising content. The disputed advertising remained subject to judicial review at the time of filing.

meta.note: The filing asserts claims without adjudicatig the accuracy of either company's advertising.

text: The U.S. Trade Representative stated that additional trade action is expected soon under Section 301 authorities. Existing Section 122 tariffs remained scheduled to expire, while Section 301 investigations and previously announced tariff actions remained active. Trade restrictions were being administered through multiple statutory authorities.

meta.note: The announced future action is excluded; only the active legal and administrative configuration is recorded.

text: Anthropic provided Claude Mythos Preview to selected financial institutions and other organizations through Project Glasswing. The Federal Reserve reported it was still seeking access while participating institutions had access to the model. Availability of the cybersecurity capability remained distributed across a limited set of organizations.

meta.note: Model availability is distinguishable from any demonstrated cybersecurity capability or outcome.
